_comment: SHARED PROTOCOL BASE for every deploy target. Pinned Base mainnet state for the USDe/USDC Morpho Blue loop: all addresses verified on-chain at the pinned block and against official sources (Morpho docs, Ethena/Basescan, Circle, Aerodrome/Basescan). Read by deploy/fork.sh, vault-service.sh and enter-loop.sh under BOTH TARGET=fork and TARGET=mainnet, and everything below is identical across the two, because the fork is a fork OF BASE at the block pinned here: same USDC, same USDe, same Morpho Blue, same Aerodrome pool. Only what genuinely differs between an anvil fork and Base itself (chain id, RPC, keys, funding, cron cadence, state dir) lives in deploy/targets/<target>.json. Downstream code must read parameters from here, not hardcode them. Kept under its original name so existing references and docs still resolve.

fork._comment: Anvil-only: which upstream chain and block the fork is taken FROM. The chain id the fork serves (31337), its port and the strike cadence moved to deploy/targets/fork.json, which is the source of truth for anything target-shaped. Ignored entirely under TARGET=mainnet.

usde.provenance: Ethena docs key-addresses / Basescan label 'Ethena: USDe Token'; symbol+decimals read on-chain

usdc.provenance: Circle native USDC on Base (circle.com blog, Basescan 'Circle: USDC Token'); symbol+decimals read on-chain

morpho.blue_provenance: docs.morpho.org addresses page (Base); code confirmed on-chain

market.provenance: Morpho blue-api.morpho.org (USDe collateral, 91.5% LLTV, ~$351M collateral on 2026-08-13); params confirmed by idToMarketParams() on-chain at pinned block
market.oracle_price_scale: 1e24 (36 + loanDecimals 6 - collateralDecimals 18); reads exactly 1e24 = $1.00 hardcoded parity at pinned block

swap_route._comment: USDC <-> USDe leg for the loop. Uniswap V3 USDe/USDC pool at fee tier 500 (0.05%). token0=USDe, token1=USDC. Deepest USDe/USDC book on any Base AMM: at read time the 0.05% pool holds ~655k USDC + ~345k USDe in-range vs the Aerodrome Slipstream 0.01% pool's ~$130 in-range, so Uniswap wins the swap route by liquidity independent of the sponsor prize. Uniswap V3 is chain-agnostic (SwapRouter02 at the same address on Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB, Avalanche and every other chain V3 deploys to); the vault's `swapRouter` immutable can point at any of them.
swap_route.provenance: Uniswap V3 SwapRouter02 and Factory on Base (docs.uniswap.org/contracts/v3/reference/deployments/base-deployments); USDe/USDC 0.05% pool derived on-chain via `IUniswapV3Factory.getPool(USDC, USDe, 500)`; in-range liquidity read via balanceOf() on both tokens at the pinned block confirms ~$1M depth.

service._comment: Vault Priime service (one service manager, one workflow: cron -> vault-nav -> aggregator -> PriimeVault). twap_window_secs bounds the Aerodrome TWAP used for min(par, TWAP) collateral pricing; inputs_block_lag is how far behind head the component pins its reads (NAV-03 self-determined height); observation_cardinality is the pool ring-buffer size ensured at bring-up so the TWAP window stays answerable across the loop-entry swaps (cardinality is 1 on mainnet at the pinned block). These three are properties of the market and the component, so they are shared across targets. The strike CADENCE is not: it is a cost, and it lives per target in deploy/targets/<target>.json.

deploy_params._comment: Placeholder strategy parameters surfaced by the deploy beat (spec UI-01). Loop entry and vault deploy scripts must take these as inputs.
deploy_params._comment_turns: max_loop_turns raised 4 -> 7: without a flash loan each borrow is health-checked against already-supplied collateral (D_k <= LLTV * C_{k-1}), so N borrow turns cap final LTV at LLTV*S_N/(1+LLTV*S_N), S_N = 1+LLTV+...+LLTV^{N-1}. N=4 caps at 76.3% even with ZERO margin at the full 91.5% LLTV; landing on 80% while keeping health factor >= health_factor_floor at every intermediate state (borrow cap per turn = lltv/health_factor_floor) takes 7 turns. enter-loop.sh solves the minimum turn count and fails if it exceeds this ceiling.
deploy_params._comment_carry: collateral_incentive_apr_bps is a fork-track placeholder for the incentive-paid carry on the USDe collateral leg (Merkl-paid in production, deliberately excluded from NAV per NAV-02). Used only by the enter-loop.sh net-spread entry gate: net = incentive APR - Morpho borrow APR (from the IRM view) must be >= min_net_spread_bps.
